Correction to the note of 2026-11-10 on experiments 1-3, item 3, the 10-galaxy age-redshift slopes (baseline +1.17, C/N free +3.96, C/N + carbon mask +0.85 Gyr per unit z; expected for one formation time in Planck18 over z = 0.654-0.891: -5.24).

The shift in slope from freeing C and N (+2.78) is not established on these 10 galaxies. Leaving one galaxy out, the shift ranges from -3.62 (without M8_161113, z = 0.891) to +5.55 (without M1_210210, z = 0.654). Galaxy bootstrap of the shift (10000 draws, seed 20261111): 16-84 percent -4.19 to +6.38, positive in 68 percent of draws.

Per-galaxy age change with C and N free, in redshift order: z 0.654 +0.94, 0.677 +0.37, 0.688 -0.75, 0.701 -0.79, 0.728 -1.33, 0.732 +0.97, 0.735 +0.25, 0.749 -0.98, 0.844 -0.23, 0.891 +1.31 Gyr. The sign follows Mg b coverage (younger in 4/5 with Mg b in range, older in 4/5 without), but in this set the two groups overlap in redshift (0.654-0.749 and 0.677-0.891), so these 10 do not show a redshift trend in the age change.

Do not use the 10-galaxy slopes as evidence for or against any setup. The 135-galaxy run (results/chronometer-135-2026-11-10) is the test.
